frozen_design.name: D fresh extended mixed-arrival fixed-cap probe
frozen_design.question: Does the small/large fixed-prefill tradeoff persist on a longer changing arrival trace, beyond the old one-burst all-failed drain?
frozen_design.motivation: R/V actionvalue survived, but timer19 absorbed K on the oldtrace. Retire K claim there; no K/R/T/controller run in this new probe. Existing fixed384 was tuned for earlier burst, and2048 is throughput-competitive; neither is declaredbestfornewtrace.
frozen_design.role: Fresh development workload for action-value/frontier exploration, not independent confirmation of a selected controller.
frozen_design.source_preservation: Only arrival_s changed; complete per-ID promptIDs,max_tokens and source metadata unchanged.
frozen_design.arrival_method: Condition on fixed counts per window; sorted uniform arrivals; seeded request-order permutation; firstarrival0. No response-dependent source throttling.
frozen_design.interpretation: Nominal low/base/burst load changes; actual capacity knee and KV pressure are outcomes, not assumed. Normal GPU .9/maxseq192 and original maxlen4096 unchanged; no artificial KV cap.
frozen_design.metrics: All arrivals/full elapsed and drain; fulljointgoodput,rawthroughput,TTFT,flow,perrequestmaxgap,allfailures,clientaddlag; actualP/D/context/backlog. Per-windowdiagnosticsnotposthocdeployableoracle.
frozen_design.decision: First require actual execution differences. One fixed cap is provisionally sufficient for the primary objective if its fulljointgoodput improves>=3% in both reversedpairs, allrequestscomplete, rawthroughputdoesnotdecrease, and TTFT/flow/maxgap p95 do not worsen>5%, with noadded100msgapfailures. Otherwise report the completefixedfrontier and whether tradeoff signs repeat; noisy/mixed signs are inconclusive. Only a reproducible tradeoff plus observable state variation warrants count/closest-dynamic comparisons and a new signal. No K rescue or posthocsegmentoracle, no automatic extra repeats/grid.
frozen_design.no_signal: No controller claim; do not manufacture pressure or retune SLO. Retain bounded fixed-budget frontier result and reassess problem within originalscope.

action_record: The fixed policy chooses its named cap on every step. budget records that choice; prefill_tokens records actual native execution. No dynamic/shadow controller.
decision_time_note: Original start_s is engine.step entry; policy is a constant and does not consume a wall-clock state signal.
